APPLY [AAAA] EDS | | BRAIN Database Account Modification on events which are detected by the LOCAL system
AND when the event(s) were detected by one or more of BRAIN, BRAIN_MSSQL
AND when an event matches any of the following BB:MSSQL Account Modification, BB:TDV Postgres Account Modification
final_rule:
rule detect_database_account_modifications {
  meta:
    author = "Your Name"
    description = "Detect unauthorized or suspicious database account modifications in MSSQL and Postgres databases."
    version = "1.0"
    rule_id = "detect_database_account_modifications"
    severity = "Medium"
  
  events:
    $mssql_event = mssql_account_modification_events
    where
      $mssql_event.source = "LOCAL" and
      $mssql_event.vendor_product in ("BRAIN", "BRAIN_MSSQL") and
      $mssql_event.event_type = "BB:MSSQL Account Modification"
      
    $postgres_event = postgres_account_modification_events
    where
      $postgres_event.source = "LOCAL" and
      $postgres_event.vendor_product in ("BRAIN", "BRAIN_MSSQL") and
      $postgres_event.event_type = "BB:TDV Postgres Account Modification"

  match: (
    $mssql_event or $postgres_event
  ) within 5 minutes
}
